# ADMIN-D8 Course mapping

Page spec: docs/build/2026-11-04-admin-workflow-map.md#D8

Build scope 2026-11-05 (D-L100, the designer asked for this page to be better): map step G13 built. Two panes, three views, levels Mandatory, Recommended, Not mapped, a draft with Save changes. Setup summary is gone; Coverage replaces its group table. Choosing a level in the selection bar applies at once, to the draft.

## Tasks
| Task | Entry | Steps | Finish | Landing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Differ by offering | By skill, one skill | Set a different level on two offerings, Save changes | Both levels kept | Same view |
| Unmapped | By skill or By course, a skill on a cohort's list | Read the level, leave it alone | Row reads Not mapped; the student can still submit | Same view |
| Many at once | By skill, a group row's checkbox | Choose a level in the selection bar, Save changes | Each selected offering has the level | Same view |
| Save from far down a long table | By skill or By course, scrolled past the header | Set a level, Save changes in the bar under the table | Saved; the page stays, the banner is in view | Same place |
| Which assigned skills have a course | Coverage, a figure | Click Assigned, In a course or In no course | The list has that many skills, chips name the group and the filter | By skill |
